decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component spraying system extends the firm's core coating expertise into demanding corrosion-protection uses, and its continued presence on the website in 2023 and 2024 signals ongoing commitment.
The low-pressure injection pump has its own page and a documented field test since 2021, so the long investment and public reference projects make it very likely to stay.
The low-pressure transfer pump reuses the firm's proven air motors and fits its material-conveying core, which keeps costs low and gives little reason to withdraw it.
Fire protection flow monitoring has its own page and supports the announced direction toward digitalized, monitored production, so management will persist with it even if uptake is slow.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system was launched only in 2024 and sits close to the core offer, so any weak early results can be attributed to the normal market ramp-up.
